per_fixture.line_timing_assessment: Median absolute offset 145ms, signed median +5ms — best timing of any backend tested on this fixture. Sub-150ms is karaoke-grade.
per_fixture.reasoning: Dense_vocal fixture. AAI Universal-3 Pro emitted 309 correctly-aligned words grouped into 29 lines (gold has 62 lines). Coverage 37% because the 800ms silence-gap line-splitter merges adjacent gold lines into single AAI lines — a line-grouping problem, not a transcription problem. Timing is the cleanest of any backend tested today (median +5ms vs gold). With a tighter line-splitter (~400ms gap) coverage should roughly double. Score 6 because timing passes the wall gate but missing 60% of gold line boundaries; not yet wall-acceptable as a finished product, but the underlying signal is right.
